question: As per the Economic Survey, 2024–25, which mission is part of India’s Space Vision, 2047, for human spaceflight?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gaganyaan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaganyaan** is India's first human spaceflight mission under the ambitious **India's Space Vision, 2047**.
 
• The mission was announced by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** on **August 15, 2018**, during his Independence Day speech.
 
• **Gaganyaan** aims to send a crew of **three astronauts** into low Earth orbit for a period of **up to seven days**.
 
• This mission is being developed under the leadership of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, with significant advancements in space technology and infrastructure.
 
• The **Economic Survey 2024–25** highlighted Gaganyaan as a key milestone in India's space exploration strategy, contributing to technological innovation and national pride.
 
• **Unmanned mission tests** for Gaganyaan are being conducted to ensure the safety and reliability of the crewed flight.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India's Space Vision, 2047:**

 
 
• A long-term strategic plan by **ISRO** to position India as a global leader in space exploration and technological development.
 
• Focuses on **human spaceflight, interplanetary missions, space station establishment**, and advancements in satellite communication.
 
• Includes missions like **Gaganyaan, Chandrayaan-3, Aditya-L1**, and future Mars exploration missions.
 
 
 
• **Gaganyaan Mission Features:**
 
 
• The spacecraft consists of an **orbital module** that houses a crew module and a service module.
 
• The crew module is equipped with **life-support systems** and environmental controls to ensure astronaut safety.
 
• ISRO plans to collaborate with international space agencies like **NASA, Roscosmos**, and the European Space Agency (ESA) for technological support.
 
• The mission will use the **GSLV Mk III rocket**, which is India's most powerful launch vehicle.
 
 
 
• **Training of Astronauts:**
 
 
• Indian astronauts, referred to as **Vyomanauts**, are undergoing specialized training for spaceflight in collaboration with **Russia**.
 
• The training includes simulations of zero-gravity conditions, survival techniques, and spacecraft operations.
 
 
 
• **Other Missions Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Vikram:** Refers to the **Vikram lander** used in Chandrayaan missions for lunar exploration. It is not a human spaceflight mission.
 
• **Samudrayaan:** A project for deep-sea exploration under the Ministry of Earth Sciences. It focuses on ocean resources and is unrelated to spaceflight.
 
• **Mangalyaan:** Also known as the Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM), launched in **2013**, aimed at studying Mars. It is an interplanetary mission and not a human spaceflight mission.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gaganyaan Budget:** The mission has an estimated cost of **₹10,000 crore**, making it one of India's most expensive space projects.
 
• **ISRO's Achievements:** Gaganyaan marks a significant milestone in ISRO's journey, which has included missions like **Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan**, and **PSLV launches**.
 
• **Global Impact:** Successful execution of Gaganyaan would position India as the **fourth nation** to achieve human spaceflight capability after the **USA, Russia**, and **China**.
 
• **Technological Innovations:** The mission will drive advancements in **aerospace engineering, robotics, life-support systems**, and **space medicine**.
 
• **Future Plans:** Following Gaganyaan, ISRO plans to explore **space station development** and interplanetary human missions.
